rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER STRENGTHENING UNION ORGANIZATION AND DISALLOWING CANCELLATION OF UNION REGISTRATION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Union Formation Act
rows.abstract:
Allows a federation, national union or industry or trade union center or an independent union to acquire legal personality and shall be entitled to the rights and privileges granted by law to legitimate organization upon NOTIFICATION OF ITS FORMATION.
Reduces the number of minimum membership requirement for registration of independent unions from twenty percent (20%) to ten percent (10%). 
Entitles the local chapter the rights and privileges of a legitimate labor organization upon submission of its charter certificate to the Department of Labor and Employment.
Mandates the Labor Relations Division in the Regional Office or the Bureau to act on all notices of union formation   
Underscores that union constitution and by-laws should govern the election of union officers.

rows.abstract:
Grants the Secretary of Labor and Employment to assume jurisdiction over the labor dispute causing or likely to cause strike or lockout in an industry engaged in essential services which if interrupted would endanger the life, personal safety or health of whole or part of the population and decide the same within fifteen (15) days after such assumption.
Requires minimum service or operation of the affected industries engaged in essential services to ensure the proper and adequate protection of the life, personal safety and health of their patients for the duration of the labor dispute.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND AUTOMATION SYSTEMS IN THE LABOR INDUSTRY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to develop transparent AI systems and governance policies, to ensure the passage of regulatory laws, and to invest in education and reskilling programs to help workers adapt to the changing landscape in the labor industry.

Intends to promote labor augmentation as employers may deem beneficial in the workplace as an administrative tool or an integrated or complementary part to process workflows.

Proposes to prohibit employers from making their decisions based solely on recommendations or results generated by AI or automated systems; to replace human workers, displacement, loss of security of tenure, or diminution of existing salaries and or benefits.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT REGULATING AVIATION PRACTICES FOR THE PROTECTION OF PASSENGERS,
AND PENALIZING ACTS IN VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract:
Seeks to protect air passengers from unfair practices and deceptive machinations in the aviation industry that violate their rights; Aims to address unjust practices to avoid personal inconvenience, missed opportunities, and economic consequences that the passengers may have to endure.
Proposes several guidelines and procedures regarding overbooking, rebooking, canceled flights, delayed flights, refunds, travel funds, and damaged, delayed, and lost luggage.
Enumerates specific reasons when an air passenger can be denied boarding; Provides for several processes and corresponding compensation when a passenger can be denied boarding due to overbooking either voluntarily or involuntarily.
